programmes.d: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

When a mysterious final stone is set at the relocated London Bridge in Arizona, it unleashes history’s most grisly killer...Jack the Ripper! And once Jack begins his killing spree, it’s a race against time for the hard-bitten cop who must stop him!
In an insane asylum, a doctor is using a cursed antique radio to enact miraculous cures on his patients.
A Satanic cult leader acquires a cursed coin that can kill with a flip and use the life force to resurrect the dead. When one member of the trio dies, the other two wonder if they can carry on.
